title: Compact-group averaging loses exactly posterior translated-score variance

setting.group: compact normalized Haar group acting orthogonally on one finite-dimensional cutoff
setting.invariance: The reference Gaussian and positive weight Omega are invariant and Omega commutes with the action.

equality: For positive smooth normalized densities, equality holds exactly when rho is group invariant.
scope_guard: This is an exact finite-dimensional Fisher identity; it does not supply a continuum limit or a lower bound on the asymptotic size of the saving.
